channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: IDF responds to Israeli film: "Internal and absurd contradictions"
item.description: IDF responds to claims of war crimes and genocide as presented on Israeli film. "The IDF categorically rejects these allegations"

item.title: CENTCOM commander: 'We're well armed and ready'
item.description: Asked on 60 Minutes about munitions shortages, US Central Command Chief Brad Cooper answered: ""I am not concerned at all. We're well armed and ready for any contingency."

item.title: A good judgment
item.description: G-d is not here to catch us but to help us reach our tikkun, rectification. Each failure is merely a test that we were unable to overcome, but G-d is not done. Another similar test will come our way to see if we can overcome it.

item.title: Minister vows to revoke citizenship over Venice film
item.description: Culture Minister Miki Zohar accuses the creators of Naza of betraying Israel after the documentary won an award at the Venice Film Festival.

item.title: Never will I forget the jumpers of 9/11
item.description: Twenty-five years later, the most unbearable images of September 11 still demand that we remember not only the victims, but the ideology that murdered them. Opinion.

item.title: Iran-Gulf meeting postponed
item.description: Omani Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi announced on Sunday that a meeting between Iran and the Gulf States to discuss the Strait of Hormuz, which was scheduled for tomorrow, has been postponed "in the interests of consensus."

item.title: British Jewish man found dead near Rabbi Nachman’s tomb in Uman
item.description: Ukrainian police investigate after 45-year-old British Jewish man is found dead in a forest near Rabbi Nachman’s tomb during Rosh Hashanah.

item.title: Likud’s move against Arab parties
item.description: Likud says it will seek to disqualify the Arab parties, citing their alleged support for terrorism and ties to hostile organizations.

item.title: Israeli and Palestinian arrested for drug smuggling on yachts
item.description: Four suspects, including an Israeli citizen, were arrested after police uncovered cocaine, cash and more than 126 kilograms of ketamine in searches near Limassol.

item.title: Katz: Whoever approaches strategic Lebanon ridge ‘will be destroyed’
item.description: Defense Minister Katz says IDF will remain in southern Lebanon’s security zone until Hezbollah is disarmed, warning anyone approaching Ali al-Taher Ridge.

item.title: Yehuda Widawski, Israel’s oldest Holocaust survivor, passes away at 107
item.description: Yehuda Widawski survived the Lodz Ghetto and Auschwitz before building a new life in Israel and dedicating decades to preserving Jewish heritage in Poland.

item.title: Former Gov. Pataki: '9/11 didn't choose between Democrat or Republican'
item.description: Former New York Governor George Pataki reflects on 9/11, the unity he witnessed in New York, and why he fears its lessons are being forgotten.

item.title: Jewish group: UK church Gaza memorial included terrorist names
item.description: Leeds Minster removes panels containing 12 names linked to Palestinian Islamic Jihad after Jewish group raises concerns over its Gaza war memorial.

item.title: IDF withdraws from Ali al-Taher Ridge, redeploys along Yellow Line
item.description: The IDF withdrew from the Ali al-Taher Ridge and redeployed along the Yellow Line. For now, troops remain in the area of Beaufort Ridge.

item.title: Leiter: UK sanctions driven by domestic politics, London looks like Baghdad
item.description: Ambassador Yechiel Leiter rejects claims that Jews are occupiers in Judea and Samaria, stressing the region’s historic, religious and strategic importance.

item.title: Berlin Jewish woman attacked over Star of David
item.description: Two suspects allegedly hurled anti-Semitic slurs before attacking a Jewish woman with a broken glass bottle in central Berlin.

item.title: NYT: Power struggle rocks Iran as leaders clash over war with US
item.description: NYT report reveals deep divisions in Iran over war and US talks, as officials question Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei’s role and authority.

item.title: Joint List and Ra'am sign surplus-vote agreement
item.description:
The Joint List and the United Arab List (Ra’am) signed a surplus-vote agreement ahead of the elections in a bid to prevent votes from going to waste.
Under the agreement, the parties pledged to conduct a “fair and clean election campaign" and refrain from smears, defamation and incitement. The agreement will be submitted to the Central Elections Committee after the candidate lists are approved.

item.title: Yamam officer found dead after disappearing while freediving in Haifa
item.description: SFC Itai Parson, 23, disappeared while freediving off Haifa as his family waited nearby; his body was located following an extensive three-day search.

item.title: Kushner: US used fallout from Qatar strike to pressure Israel on Gaza deal
item.description: Trump envoy Jared Kushner says US administration capitalized on Israel's growing diplomatic isolation following failed Doha strike to push Israeli government toward Gaza agreement.

item.title: IDF eliminates two terrorists in Hamas’ engineering unit
item.description:
Earlier today (Sunday), the IDF struck in the Gaza City area and eliminated the terrorists Hassan Ali Abu Nada and Abd al-Rahim Ahmad Khalil Khawa, operatives in the engineering unit of Hamas’ military wing.
Recently, the terrorists were involved in the production and development of weapons, advanced terror attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians, and attempted to reconstitute the terrorist organization’s capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorists were eliminated in order to remove the threat they posed.

item.title: Shabbat Shalom and Shana Tova!
item.description:
Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat and Rosh Hashanah in North America, where they are being written now.
Updates will resume Sunday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Rosh Hashanah at 19:24 Jerusalem time.
Shabbat Shalom and Shana Tova!

item.title: Ambassador Leiter: Rosh Hashanah calls us to defend freedom and seek peace
item.description:
Israel's Ambassador to the US Yechiel Leiter reflects on Rosh Hashanah, September 11 and Charlie Kirk, calling for peace, resilience, freedom and life.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Rosh Hashanah in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)
